name: Sendai Station Brewery Fermenteria
native: 仙台駅ブルワリー ファーメンテリア
about: Sendai Station Brewery Fermenteria is a small brewery on the first floor of Sendai Station, run by the company Shokagura. It opened in spring 2024. The name joins the word fermentation with an ending that means a shop.

Thirty clear tanks line a wall so visitors can watch rice turn into sake. The layout is based on MiCURA, a home sake-brewing kit developed by the company's head. Its craft sake and fermented drinks are sold to take away and supplied to the restaurants around the brewery.
